prompt.zh-TW: 河岸麵包坊今年的稅前淨利是 {{money:vars.pretax}}，所得稅費用 {{money:vars.tax}}。大東說：「稅前淨利就是我們今年真正賺到、可以留在店裡的錢。」他說得對嗎？
prompt.en: Riverside Bakery's profit before tax this year is {{money:vars.pretax}}, and income tax expense is {{money:vars.tax}}. Tung says profit before tax is what the shop really earned and can keep this year. Is he right?

text.zh-TW: 不對，還要扣掉所得稅費用，本期淨利才是最後留下的
text.en: No, income tax expense still has to be deducted; profit for the period is what remains

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。稅前淨利是倒數第二層，最後一層才是本期淨利。
feedback.en: Correct. Profit before tax is the second-to-last level; the last level is profit for the period.

text.zh-TW: 對，稅前淨利已經扣完所有該扣的項目
text.en: Yes, profit before tax already has everything deducted

feedback.zh-TW: 名字裡的「稅前」就是提示：所得稅還沒扣。再往下一層才是本期淨利。
feedback.en: The words "before tax" are the clue: income tax has not been deducted yet. One level further down is profit for the period.

text.zh-TW: 不對，應該用營業利益，因為那才是本業賺的
text.en: No, operating profit should be used, because that is what the core business earned

feedback.zh-TW: 營業利益確實反映本業，但它還沒扣業外收支和所得稅，不是最後留下的金額。
feedback.en: Operating profit does reflect the core business, but it is still before non-operating items and income tax, so it is not the final amount kept.

explanation.zh-TW: 五層利益的最後一層是本期淨利＝稅前淨利－所得稅費用，所以{{option:o_85qt}}正確。{{option:o_80pe}}漏了所得稅這一層；{{option:o_qwed}}回答的是另一個問題（本業賺多少），不是最後留下多少。
explanation.en: The last of the five levels is profit for the period = profit before tax less income tax expense, so {{option:o_85qt}} is right. {{option:o_80pe}} skips the tax level, and {{option:o_qwed}} answers a different question (what the core business earned) rather than what is finally kept.
